dedupe_keys.name: slu seec wastewater virus surveillance in sweden sars cov 2 influenza a and b rsv

description: This continuously updated dataset reports weekly respiratory virus levels in raw wastewater from treatment plants across Sweden: SARS-CoV-2, influenza A and B and RSV, measured by RT-qPCR in 24-hour flow-proportional composite samples and given as genome copies, ratios normalised by pepper mild mottle virus as a faecal marker, and copies per day per inhabitant. Monitoring began in Uppsala in August 2020 and grew into a national system covering about 43 percent of the Swedish population. The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences group of Anna J. Székely runs it with the plants, and the data are available as a free download from the SLU-SEEC dashboards on the Swedish Pathogens Portal, with a CC BY 4.0 metadata record on SciLifeLab figshare. Coverage is national. Caveats: values are preliminary and may be revised, and assays changed in 2023. Simulation uses: sewershed-level outbreak signals for emergency response and public-health digital twins linked to wastewater systems. Related records: Germany's AMELAG (data-rki-amelag-wastewater-surveillance) and the PHES-ODM data standard (data-phes-odm-environmental-surveillance-open-data-model).
